descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S03 「输入方式 × 模式 → Save Note 后的卡片数（一个框里的多行、一张多行卡片、只差大小写的重复和完全重复）」 Entry method x mode -> number of cards after Save Note (lines in one box, a multi-line card, case-only and exact duplicates)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57).（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; …（TFA-92590 AC 4；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Fresh physician, one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, no points

When Hospital: one Add Point box holding three lines, Save Point; then two points that differ only in case; Save Note. Nursing Home: three lines typed into the editor's bottom points box, Save Note; then on the panel one card with an internal line break and the same point added twice; Save Note again

Then Decision table (entry x mode -> cards after Save Note): (a) Hospital, separate Add Point entries -> 3 (S01). (b) Nursing Home, separate Add Point entries -> 3 (S02). (c) Nursing Home, three lines in the editor's bottom box -> 3 cards (UAT 'entered on separate lines', PR #57). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Backend read only (oracleRules 1): a snapshot cannot count cards or see case, so the checkpoints are evidence. Judged: (c) the three texts as three cards; (d) the three texts not lost or reworded, the card count recorded for Q3; (e) exactly one card 'Ask son re: hearing aids\nand new glasses' after Save Note (U3, T5; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
